_doc: Ring bends v2 (2026-11-18). User: curve them nicely, like PoE, one node per curve. Each bend is three hand-placed points (ring node, one middle node, the shape top or bottom node) drawn as one arc through them. Mirrored per land; Water and Wood per side at the Wind start. Replaces curves.json.
